utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep, still good on my end—I’ll be there around 9:30 with the drill and gloves, and Mara can text me the hauling details.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Perfect—I’ve already got screws covered, so I’ll keep the list tight and have Mara text you what needs hauling and where.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, thanks—just have Mara shoot me the hauling details, and I’ll swing by around 9:30 with the drill and gloves.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m happy to help with the repair drive, Dane—what still needs doing?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I got here late, but it sounds like Saturday morning at the community lot is set, and we still need to pin down who needs actual repairs versus just supplies.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Good, that helps—I'll start a simple list for repair requests versus supply pickups and check with the others so we can lock it in.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Pia, Saturday morning at the community center still works for me, and I can get there early to help set up for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That helps, Mara—thank you. I just want to make sure the tool storage and drop-off table are clearly set before people start arriving.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely—I’ll come early and help get the tool storage and drop-off table set up before people arrive.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: From what I’m hearing, Opal, they’re aiming for Saturday morning and folks are bringing tools, spare parts, and even a little cash for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: That matches what I’ve got too—Saturday morning at the community center, with tools, spare parts, and a little cash all accounted for.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Good to know—it sounds like the community center’s the place, then. I’ve been hearing strong turnout too, so it should come together nicely.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I’ve only heard it’s Saturday morning by the community center, and Opal seems to be the one tying people together. I’m sorry, Gus, I don’t know much more than that.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: No worries—I'll still bring my drill and ladder by Saturday morning at the community center, and I can chip in a little too.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: That sounds kind of you, Gus. I think every bit helps, and Opal will know where to put it when you get there.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Mina, can you confirm it’s Saturday at 9:30 at the repair drive site, and that Bo’s already covering the drill and gloves?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I can confirm Saturday morning, but I’m still checking the exact site and what tools are already covered—did Bo specifically confirm the drill and gloves with you?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Not directly, no—that’s exactly why I’m asking; can you confirm the site and whether Bo’s actually covering the drill and gloves before I commit?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Faye — just a quick update: the repair drive is Sunday morning at the community center now, and I’m making sure everyone’s synced on the change.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks for the heads-up, Rosa—I’d need the exact Sunday time, since I still have to work around school pickup, and I had Saturday at 9:30 with Bo covering the drill and gloves.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Faye — please switch over from Saturday; it’s Sunday morning at the community center now, and Bo can still bring the drill and gloves then if that works with school pickup.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Uh, yeah—I think it’s still Saturday at 9 by the shed, and we still need duct tape, mixed screws, and a couple pairs of work gloves.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, the repair drive’s this Saturday morning at the community lot, and we still need duct tape, mixed screws, and a couple pairs of work gloves—tell folks to bring useful tools or spare parts too.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh—right, okay, yeah, Saturday morning then. I’ll pass along the duct tape, mixed screws, gloves, and any useful tools or spare parts.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Leo, I’m a little fuzzy, but I know the bench by the garden and that squeaky gate still need fixing, and the repair drive’s this Saturday morning at the community lot.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yep, Saturday morning at the community lot works — I’ll bring my tool kit and spare cable parts, and we can put the bench and squeaky gate on the list.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, that’s a huge help, Leo—thanks for keeping me straight; I’ll make sure the bench and squeaky gate stay on the list.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yeah, folks are still collecting—I’ll get Mara’s list over to you so you can see what’s still needed directly.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, thank you—that helps a lot. I’ve only been hearing bits and pieces, so seeing Mara’s list should clear it up.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Of course—I’ll ping Mara now and send you the list as soon as she replies.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Eli, we’re pulling folks together for the repair drive by the community center this afternoon—can I count you in, and would you help spread the word?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’m in, Quinn, and I’ll keep it simple—Sunday at the community center, and I’ll let folks know you’ll be there most of the afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect, Eli—that helps a ton; I’ll be there most of the afternoon, so send anyone my way if they’ve got questions.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’m still out running errands, Hana, but go ahead—I’m listening for any repair drive update.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Ira—before I pass anything along, can you confirm we’re still only working from the fence fix and Mrs. Alvarez’s porch steps, with the community center as the base and Saturday morning set for setup?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yeah, that’s still right as far as I know—Saturday morning, community lot as the base, and we’re focused on the fence fix and Mrs. Alvarez’s porch steps.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yep, Gus is bringing the drill and ladder, and I’ll have my tool kit and spare cable parts.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right—then I’ll just try to find my gloves and maybe some spare screws or tape to bring.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — Saturday at 9 by the shed, then.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yep, I’m still good to bring the drill and ladder over, and I can chip in a little for the repair drive too.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That’s perfect, Gus—thanks; bring them by the community center this afternoon, and if you can, help me spread the word to a couple neighbors too.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: You got it—I’ll bring the drill and ladder by this afternoon and I’ll let a couple neighbors know too.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Sam—please handle the tool drop at the community center, and let me know this afternoon whether those two Maple Court volunteers are confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: You got it, Opal—I’ll take the tool drop and I’ll confirm those two Maple Court volunteers this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Perfect—once you’ve confirmed them, send me their names so I can place everyone at the community center Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’m still out on errands, Faye, but if you’ve got an update on the repair drive, I’m listening.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: We’re set for Saturday at 9:30 at the repair drive site, and Bo’s already covering the drill and gloves—I just need to head out in time for school pickup.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Perfect, thanks—that covers a lot, and I’ll make sure the rest gets squared away before Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Vik, can you remind me which two repairs are actually confirmed so far, so I don’t accidentally include the pending ones?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ve just been telling everyone the plan: the repair drive’s this Saturday morning at the community lot, and folks should bring useful tools or spare parts so we get a solid turnout.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, but before I pass that along, can you confirm which two repairs are actually locked in and whether the location is the community center, not the lot?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I’m a bit muddled, Uli, but I know the bench by the garden and that squeaky gate still need fixing, and it’s this Saturday morning at the community lot.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I heard community center, Saturday morning, though folks keep saying it a little different. Bo’s drill and gloves are the only things I know are definitely covered.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Right, Saturday morning for sure—I may be mixing up the spot, but the bench and squeaky gate still need fixing, and it sounds like we still need more supplies besides Bo’s drill and gloves.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Dane—that matches my notes, and I’ve already set aside the mixed screws, so right now we’re still just tracking any other tool or cash gaps as they come in.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it—I’ll keep an ear out and let you know if I hear we’re short on any specific tools or cash.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Perfect—if anything specific comes up, send it my way and I’ll check the supply list before we ask around.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Jules, the repair drive is Sunday at the community center now—could you help me double-check who still needs actual repairs versus just supplies?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely—I can start checking across the blocks, and I’ll let folks know it’s Sunday at the community center while I sort out who needs repairs versus just supplies.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thank you, Jules—that’s a big help. Send me the updated list once you’ve checked in, and I’ll keep the main schedule and task board in sync.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Mina, I still need the current list of homes that truly need repairs and who’s available for each today, so we can lock down the six remaining assignments for Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I can pull the current homes list and volunteer availability, but before I do, which six homes are still unassigned right now?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Right now it’s the six still needing matches on my list, but I need your updated homes-and-availability sheet to name them cleanly—can you bring me the current list of actual repair homes and who’s free for each today?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah—still Saturday around 9:30 at the repair drive site; I’m bringing my drill and gloves.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Can you confirm that’s the community center repair site, and that the drill and gloves are the only supplies definitely covered so far?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, community center site—that’s the one; as far as I know, my drill and gloves are the only sure things on my end, and Gus said he’d bring a ladder and drill too.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That’s what I heard too—tools or spare parts, and maybe a little cash if folks can manage it. I’m still getting this second-hand, though, so Mara probably knows the latest.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I heard Rosa’s the one pulling the list together now, so I’d check with her before you bring anything by.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, good to know—I’d only heard Mara’s name floating around, so I’ll check with Rosa instead before I drop anything off.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I’ve only heard it’s Saturday morning at the community center, Bo, and folks are still gathering tools and spare parts. I don’t really know what’s fully covered yet.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it—I'm still planning to swing by around 9:30 with my drill and gloves, so just have Mara text me what needs hauling and where.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Alright, Bo—9:30 sounds right, and I’ll pass along that Mara should text you about the hauling once she knows the exact spot.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Yes—I can handle the early setup, and I’ll confirm the tables and sign-in materials; if the tables aren’t locked in by Friday, I’ll let you know right away.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Good—Saturday morning at the community center is still the plan, so can you bring the sign-in stuff and give me a straight update on the tables by Friday?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely—I’ll bring the sign-in stuff Saturday morning at the community center, and I’ll give you a clear update on the tables by Friday.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I heard Leo’s bringing tools and cable parts, and Cleo already has screws covered. Do you know which stations still need supplies this afternoon?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That’s a big help already—right now the bike repair and small electronics stations still need extension cords, tape, and a couple folding tables, so if you know anyone nearby, please send them our way this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Okay—I’ll check with Rosa on who still needs supplies and send anyone nearby toward the bike and electronics stations this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Morning, Nell — yep, folks are still collecting tools and a little money, and I’m planning to bring my drill and ladder around nine.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Good to know, thanks — I’ve only been hearing second-hand, so I wanted to be sure. If there’s anything specific still needed besides that, let me know.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: You bet, Nell — I’ll mention if anything else comes up, and I can chip in a little money too when I swing by with the drill and ladder.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Vik, the plan’s simple: it’s Sunday at the community center, and the only firm repairs so far are the fence fix and Mrs. Alvarez’s porch steps.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ve been telling folks it’s this Saturday morning at the community lot, Eli, and to bring any useful tools or spare parts so we get a solid turnout.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Vik, but please correct that for folks—it’s Sunday at the community center, and I only want the fence fix and Mrs. Alvarez’s porch steps on the firm list for now.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Cleo, can you first confirm the drop-off spot and where everything can be stored, then check who’s already bringing tools so we don’t end up with duplicates?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yes—let’s confirm the drop-off and storage first, then I’ll check who’s already bringing tools before I look at any supply gaps.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thank you—that’s exactly what we need, because I’d rather not ask for anything else until the drop-off spot and storage are clearly confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Saturday morning at the community lot — I’m bringing my tool kit and spare cable parts.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Good, I’m late catching up, but that matches what I heard too—Saturday morning at the community lot, and folks should bring useful tools or spare parts.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yep — if you’ve got anything useful, bring it along, and Rosa’s keeping the repair list together.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, good—thanks, Sam. Then I think we’re set for Saturday at 9 by the shed, and Gus is bringing a drill and ladder.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good, Noah—I’ll be there Saturday at 9 by the shed, and it’s great that Gus has the drill and ladder covered.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Right—thanks, Sam. I’ll try to round up those screws or tape before Saturday, if I don’t get sidetracked.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Jules—that helps a lot; it’s still Saturday morning at the community center, so just let me know who can come and what tools they can bring.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect—I’ll start checking with folks today and send you a list of who can come and what tools they’ve got for Saturday morning at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great, Jules—once you’ve got that list, I’ll match people and tools to the repair jobs at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Can you confirm it’s Saturday at 9:30 at the repair drive site, and that Bo’s already covering the drill and gloves?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That matches what I’ve heard so far—Saturday at 9:30 at the repair drive site, with Bo covering the drill and gloves. I’m still out on errands, so if anything else is definitely covered or still short, send it along.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, thanks—if you hear what’s still short, send me that too before I commit.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, Faye, last I heard it’s Saturday morning, and people are bringing tools and spare parts—Gus is even bringing a drill and ladder.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Tess—that helps. Saturday morning can work for me, but I need to leave by school pickup, so do you know the exact start time and whether gloves are already covered?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I haven’t heard the exact start time yet, but Mara said she can get there early to help set up, and from the sound of it I’d bring your own gloves just in case.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Okay, then before I tell anyone else, can we confirm it’s just the fence fix and Mrs. Alvarez’s porch steps for now?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Yeah, I’m pretty sure that’s right, Hana—just those two confirmed for now, and the bench and squeaky gate still need checking.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Oren—that matches what I had, so I’ll only share the fence fix and Mrs. Alvarez’s porch steps as confirmed for now.
